what: ElevenLabs audio for the Riff v5 hype video (Riff hype video thread). A person (Maya) designs a coffee shop brand by talking to Riff, a Mac design app that talks back.
api_key: Read ELEVENLABS_API_KEY from the generating session's environment. Never write the key into any file, log, script in /mnt/project-files, memory or message.
output_format: mp3_44100_192 (if the plan refuses it, use mp3_44100_128)

Maya.character: Late 20s coffee shop owner. Natural, warm, casual, a little excited. Talking to her computer, not performing.

Riff.character: The AI design partner. Calm, warm, confident, a touch playful. Sounds like a real friendly person, never robotic or announcer-like.

voices.note: If a voice_id is not available on the account, pick the closest premade voice from GET /v1/voices and record which one in the manifest.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Make me a website for my coffee shop.
lines.v3_text: Make me a website for my coffee shop.

lines.speaker: Riff
lines.text: Done. Want an app to go with it?
lines.v3_text: [warmly] Done. Want an app to go with it?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Yes! Same look as the site.
lines.v3_text: [excited] Yes! Same look as the site.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Can it remember my usual order?
lines.v3_text: [curious] Can it remember my usual order?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: We open Friday. Can you make a poster?
lines.v3_text: We open Friday. Can you make a poster?

lines.speaker: Riff
lines.text: Want a story for Instagram too?
lines.v3_text: [curious] Want a story for Instagram too?

lines.speaker: Riff
lines.text: I made you a few extras, too.
lines.v3_text: [proud] I made you a few extras, too.

jobs.name: dialogue_v3
jobs.why: One continuous conversation sounds most natural (real turn-taking, consistent voices). The video thread splits it into lines itself.
jobs.body: inputs = all 18 lines in order as {text: v3_text, voice_id: primary voice of the speaker}; model_id = eleven_v3; settings.stability = 0.5
jobs.output: voices/dialogue_v3_take1.mp3 (take2, take3) plus voices/dialogue_v3_take1.json etc. holding the returned alignment / voice_segments with the audio_base64 field removed

jobs.name: lines_v2_primary
jobs.body: text = line.text (no brackets); model_id = eleven_multilingual_v2; voice_settings = {stability: 0.4, similarity_boost: 0.8, style: 0.3, use_speaker_boost: true}; previous_text / next_text = the neighbouring lines' text so the delivery flows like one conversation; seed = 7

jobs.name: lines_v2_alternate
jobs.same_as: lines_v2_primary but with the alternate voice of each speaker

jobs.name: music
jobs.endpoint: POST https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/music (check the API reference if a parameter is rejected)

body.prompt: Instrumental only. A premium, minimal Apple-commercial style track. Warm felt piano plays a simple hopeful four-note motif over a soft pulsing synth and light finger snaps, around 112 BPM, major key. Starts intimate and sparse, then gradually adds a gentle kick, deep round bass, airy pads and bright plucks, building confidence and wonder. Clean, modern, spacious mix with tasteful restraint. Peaks around 30 seconds, then resolves to a soft final piano chord that rings out by 40 seconds. No vocals, no harsh synths, no EDM drop.

takes.body_note: Same style, but as a composition_plan if the API accepts one, so the sections line up with the edit:

report: Write voices/manifest.json listing every file written (job, path, voice used, duration) and every failure with its HTTP status and message. Do the priority 1 jobs first. Then tell the Riff hype video thread they are ready.
